function.name: world_status
function.description: Read selected current world states such as time, weather, lighting or event flags. Values come from the game; null is unknown. This advances no clock and changes no state.

function.name: location_lookup
function.description: Look up the host-bound current location, its summary, description and visible scene details. This moves nobody and invents no facts.

function.name: info_lookup
function.description: Look up reported information about a subject and attribute. Claims are unverified.
